title: Composing Components
description: Learn how to combine components to build complex user interfaces.

data.text: **Component composition** is the act of combining multiple components to build more complex UIs. This is one of React's most powerful features - you build small, focused components and combine them to create complex interfaces.
Let's build a page layout by composing smaller components together.

data.title: Layout Components
Page Composition

data.text: Let's create a more complex example - a product card that uses composition.

data.title: Product Card Components
data.content: Building a card with multiple components

data.text: When rendering lists, each item should have a unique `key` prop to help React identify which items changed.

data.title: Rendering Lists
data.content: Using map to render components from arrays

data.title: Keys are Important
data.text: Always use stable, unique identifiers as keys (like IDs from your data). Avoid using array indices as keys when the list can change, as this can cause rendering issues.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Compose small components to build complex UIs
Each component should have a single responsibility
Props flow down, making data flow predictable
data.takeaway: Component composition is the heart of React. Next, let's learn about state and events.
